manifest.supervision: Center loss only inside complete marked cells; unmarked cells and all regions outside manual target masks are ignored. Box loss only near marked centers. No shape filtering; no test crops; no synthetic or source background negatives.
manifest.architecture: Two-level tiny 3D encoder/decoder; heatmap + six positive box-face distances; output stride 2.

center_calibration.policy: Center must lie inside a complete manual cell and within 2 µm of its EDT interior seed. One-to-one per manual cell. Padded AABB coverage compares physical box extents. Unknown/unmarked cells are unscorable, not false positives. Validation selects highest confidence retaining >=95% of maximum matched marked centers. No test-based selection.

manifest.selection_status: Frozen; thresholds selected from validation only, before new test inference.

manifest.supervision: Sparse manual objects; unknown=-1; reviewed background=0
manifest.calibration: Maximum complete-reference Dice on validation acquisitions; unknown objects unscored.

manifest.input: Normalized membrane + physical Gaussian seed; target-conditioned full 3D mask.
manifest.output: Target-cell logits; no star-convex, sphericity or elongation constraint.
manifest.supervision: Every complete manual training cell retained. Frozen matched predicted boxes supply crop geometry and seeds; unmatched marked cells use manual boxes. Other cells are not members of this target, not global negative examples. Validation checkpoint boundary score uses only the original 441 matched validation identities; all 574 validation targets still evaluated for loss. Test targets never cached.

samples.policy: Every training cell once per epoch; no roundness selection. Synthetic negatives supplement targets; no reviewed real negatives available.

manifest.checkpoint_selection: Validation physical boundary error with non-increasing volume MAPE; epoch zero retained if no improvement
manifest.selection_policy: Frozen before test. Original-grid validation symmetric surface error on fixed 441 matches, non-increasing baseline volume MAPE and >=99% original IoU matches. All test outliers retained.

stages.rationale: Asymmetric loss failed to improve its parent. Control separates the residual architecture from that loss setting; registered before the control and without any test evaluation.

experiment.current_stage: Validation selection frozen after residual loss control

selection.policy: Validation observed scores only: maximize recall at target precision with at least 5 detections; otherwise maximize F0.5. Matching within same cell and channel at declared physical tolerance. Stored curve may be downsampled; selection is exact.

manifest.score_note: Learned heatmap peak score; validation-calibrated, not a probability of correctness.
manifest.inference_policy: whole cell crop, padded to a multiple of eight

policy: All 144 held-out scans. Frozen baseline cell detections reused; learned contour guidance, signal-center NN, filtering and physical mesh measurements freshly executed. Complete manual cells only for primary errors, original manual A-B segments only, all outliers retained. No exported scan duplication.
limitations: Brush-band metrics do not imply exact surface accuracy. Measurement errors are conditional on matched cells/signals. Manual cell annotation is incomplete. Validation and test acquisitions have been previously inspected; this is not a new blind cohort.
